const s = document.defaultView.getSelection(); if (s.rangeCount > 0) { const range = s.getRangeAt(0); if (!range.collapsed) { const el = range.commonAncestorContainer; const m = (el.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE ? el.parentElement : el).closest('b'); if (m) { while (m.firstChild) { m.parentNode.insertBefore(m.firstChild, m); } m.remove(); s.removeAllRanges(); } else { const bold = document.createElement('b'); try { range.surroundContents(bold); } catch (e) { const contents = range.extractContents(); bold.appendChild(contents); range.insertNode(bold); } s.removeAllRanges(); } } }
